purpose: Exploratory market-conditioned expert information test; no new independent holdout or production promotion
evidence_tier: retrospective claimed-publication only; actual pregame receipt and executable-price certification remain zero

sources.frames: raw_frames path and SHA from the same inputs/provenance.json

eligibility: actual_votes only; do not turn proxy rows into expert observations
exact event id, league, kickoff and source team identity; source publication claim <= decision <= T-30
same target fullgame outcomes, full saved odds vector and official-linked result; no fabricated prices or missing votes
within-event one vote per source+author; opposing repeated author votes excluded; equal document SHA clustered only within that event; absent hash uses distinct source+author key
all original folds/records already inspected historically: reuse is exploratory, never blind or prospective

split_UTC.label_availability_proxy: kickoff + 96 hours; assumption not actual receipt/final-time certification

formula: z_vk=1(vote=k)-market_p[k]; within each exact-document group average beta(source,author,league)*z, then average groups; p=softmax(log(market_p)+contribution); coefficient global + league + league/source/author, unseen terms zero

candidates.parameters: global coefficient only; ridge strength1, bound[-2,2]
global ridge1 bound[-2,2]; league ridge4 bound[-1,1]; league/source/author ridge16 bound[-1,1]

fit: scipy L-BFGS-B deterministic zero initial point; softmax likelihood + 0.5*sum(lambda*coef^2); analytic gradient; maxiter500 ftol1e-12; no post-result hyperparameter search
selection: validation mean logloss overall, minimum30 valid validation events; tie1e-12 prefers simpler candidate market then global then hierarchical; select once before test; no per-league re-selection
modes: primary frozen refit on all labels available before 2026-07-01, unchanged parameters throughout test
secondary prequential: selected configuration refit once per UTC decision day using only prior labels available via +96h; separate from frozen results
controls: recomputed fixed91 = .9*market_p+.1*eligible expert group directional frequency, argmax; not frozen production replay
direction-only equal-author vote, unique plurality or abstain; no calibrated probability assigned
metrics: same fixture/price unit stake single-game accuracy, ROI, logloss, Brier, coverage, pick changes
per league counts and total; monthly unit P&L and daily-close max drawdown, without paper-wallet monthly-stop simulation
paired calendar-week block bootstrap5000 seed20261031 for selected-vs-market accuracy/ROI; raw league n<30 flagged descriptive only; no profit guarantees
falsification: future/current outcome poisoning must leave current prediction identical
forecast API cannot accept target outcome; no current-score inputs
same exact document copied within an event cannot multiply its information weight
author prior unseen defaults to zero offset; market-only parameter zero exactly reproduces market
independent Decimal odds settlement and no output state mutation
scope: local research only; no production model switch, budget change, deployment, restart, external messaging or recurring task
